verdict.rationale: Zero's README makes a first-party privacy claim that it does not track, collect, or sell user data, and it offers self-hosting. Together these imply user email is not harvested for model training, but nothing explicitly addresses AI training. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or opt-out that user data is never used to train AI models, disclosure of whether the third-party AI providers it uses (e.g., Perplexity) retain or train on data, a privacy policy or DPA, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Zero does not track, collect, or sell your data in any way.
gives users the power to **self-host** their own email app
